name: Zepbound / Mounjaro (tirzepatide)
why: Category leader in incretins; label keeps widening (OSA, HFpEF); likely the world's top-selling drug into the 2030s.

name: Foundayo (orforglipron)
why: Oral small-molecule GLP-1, approved 1 Apr 2026, no food/water rules, cheap to make; self-pay from $149/mo. Built for global primary-care scale.

name: retatrutide
why: GIP/GLP-1/glucagon triple agonist; TRIUMPH-1 28.3% weight loss at 80 wk (12 mg). Filing expected ~2027; sets the efficacy ceiling.

name: Wegovy / Ozempic / Wegovy pill (semaglutide)
indication: Obesity, T2D, CV risk, MASH, CKD
why: Broadest outcomes evidence in class; Wegovy pill launched Jan 2026 (~$350M Q1). Ex-US generics from 2026, US LOE early 2030s.

name: Keytruda / Keytruda Qlex (pembrolizumab)
why: Largest oncology drug; US LOE 2028. Subcutaneous Qlex conversion and combos decide how steep the cliff is.

name: CagriSema (cagrilintide + semaglutide)
why: Amylin + GLP-1 combo filed Dec 2025; FDA decision expected around Q4 2026. Novo's main answer to tirzepatide.

name: Enhertu (trastuzumab deruxtecan)
why: Template ADC moving into first-line and early breast cancer; patent life well into the 2030s.

name: daraxonrasib
why: RASolute 302: OS 13.2 vs 6.7 mo (HR 0.40). First broad RAS(ON) drug; 1L pancreatic, lung and colorectal trials follow.

name: Dupixent (dupilumab)
indication: Atopic dermatitis, asthma, COPD, CSU, EoE, BP
why: Type-2 inflammation franchise still adding indications (COPD, CSU, BP); exclusivity runs into the 2030s.

name: MariTide (maridebart cafraglutide)
why: Monthly GLP-1 agonist / GIPR antibody; MARITIME-1/2 primary completion from Jan 2027. Tolerability and titration still open questions.

name: Kisunla (donanemab)
why: Finite-duration amyloid therapy; $124M Q1 2026. Blood tests and subcutaneous follow-ons (remternetug) widen access.

name: trontinemab
why: Brain-shuttle anti-amyloid with fast plaque clearance and low ARIA in Ph2; TRONTIER and PrevenTRON Ph3 complete ~2028.

name: Lipfendra (enlicitide)
why: First oral PCSK9 inhibitor, approved 15 Jul 2026. A pill could take PCSK9 into mass primary care; CORALreef outcomes trial pending.

name: Baxfendy (baxdrostat)
why: Aldosterone synthase inhibitor approved 15 May 2026; huge population; dapagliflozin combo in CKD next.

name: sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT)
indication: TROP2+ lung, breast and other tumors
why: TROP2 ADC with more than 10 global Ph3s; candidate centrepiece of Merck's post-Keytruda portfolio.

name: ivonescimab
why: PD-1xVEGF bispecific; US PDUFA 14 Nov 2026. HARMONi-3 squamous interim PFS missed its bar (May 2026); final data pending.

name: Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan)
indication: HR+ and triple-negative breast cancer, NSCLC
why: TROP2 ADC; TNBC and 1L lung (AVANZAR, data moved to Q1 2027) decide whether it becomes a blockbuster.

name: Yeztugo / Sunlenca (lenacapavir)
why: Twice-yearly injectable PrEP; could reset HIV prevention globally; base for long-acting treatment combos.

name: obicetrapib
why: Oral CETP inhibitor with strong LDL and Lp(a) lowering; PREVAIL outcomes trial is the key catalyst.

name: icotrokinra
why: First oral IL-23 receptor peptide; injectable-like efficacy in a pill. Filed 2025; launch expected 2026–27.

name: Skyrizi (risankizumab)
why: Replaced Humira as AbbVie's growth engine; IBD share still rising.

name: Rinvoq (upadacitinib)
indication: RA, AD, IBD, GCA; alopecia, vitiligo, SLE trials
why: JAK1 inhibitor with expanding label; new dermatology and lupus indications extend the runway.

name: lepodisiran
why: Once- or twice-yearly siRNA; ACCLAIM-Lp(a) (17,300 patients) completes ~2029. Class discounted after pelacarsen's Sept 2026 miss; contrarian call.

name: olpasiran
why: siRNA with ~95% Lp(a) lowering; OCEAN(a)-Outcomes will test the Lp(a) hypothesis again after HORIZON.

name: Casgevy (exagamglogene autotemcel)
why: First approved CRISPR therapy; slow, centre-limited ramp, but it proves the gene-editing cure model.

name: Journavx (suzetrigine)
indication: Acute pain; DPN and LSR trials
why: First NaV1.8 non-opioid painkiller; chronic-pain indications would multiply its value.

name: povetacicept
indication: IgA nephropathy; other B-cell kidney disease
why: Dual BAFF/APRIL inhibitor; RAINIER interim supports accelerated filing; best-in-class potential.

name: zimislecel (VX-880)
why: Stem-cell islets that made patients insulin-independent; dosing resumed after a manufacturing review; no filing date yet.

name: eloralintide
why: Amylin agonist with up to ~20% weight loss in Ph2; Ph3 under way; combo partner for tirzepatide.

name: amycretin
why: GLP-1/amylin unimolecular agonist; Ph3 started 2026; Novo's next-generation bet.

name: survodutide
why: GLP-1/glucagon dual agonist with a MASH angle; SYNCHRONIZE Ph3 results due.

name: tulisokibart
why: Anti-TL1A with companion diagnostic; Ph3 ARTEMIS/ATLAS readouts ~2027–28.

name: duvakitug
why: Anti-TL1A with strong Ph2b remission rates; Ph3 started 2025.

name: asundexian
why: Oral factor XIa inhibitor; OCEANIC-STROKE positive (2025). Bleeding-sparing anticoagulation is a large prize.

name: milvexian
why: Oral factor XIa; LIBREXIA-ACS stopped for futility, but AF and stroke trials continue.

name: abelacimab
why: Monthly factor XI antibody; LILAC-TIMI 76 outcome trial is the catalyst.

name: laroprovstat (AZD0780)
why: Oral PCSK9 without a fasting requirement; AZURE-LDL/HeFH Ph3 data Q1 2027 (JPM est. $3.2B peak).

name: Cobenfy (xanomeline-trospium)
why: First new antipsychotic mechanism in decades; adjunctive ARIA trial missed; ADEPT readouts drive upside.

name: Attruby (acoramidis)
why: Near-complete TTR stabiliser with a strong outcomes signal; growing share in a fast-growing, under-diagnosed disease.

name: Amvuttra (vutrisiran)
why: Quarterly RNAi silencer with HELIOS-B outcomes win; ATTR-CM launch is driving Alnylam's growth.

name: nucresiran
why: Next-gen, potentially twice-yearly TTR silencer; TRITON-CM Ph3 extends the franchise into the 2040s.

name: zilebesiran
why: Twice-yearly siRNA against angiotensinogen; global outcomes trial started 2025. Adherence-proof BP control.

name: Winrevair (sotatercept)
why: Disease-modifying activin trap; moving earlier in PAH treatment after ZENITH and HYPERION outcomes wins.

name: Rezdiffra (resmetirom)
why: First approved MASH drug; MAESTRO-NASH OUTCOMES in compensated cirrhosis is the next leg.

name: efruxifermin
why: FGF21 analog that reversed cirrhosis fibrosis in Ph2b; SYNCHRONY Ph3. Pairs with semaglutide.

name: Carvykti (ciltacabtagene autoleucel)
why: Best-in-class BCMA CAR-T with OS benefit in second line; capacity is the constraint.

name: Rybrevant + Lazcluze (amivantamab + lazertinib)
why: MARIPOSA OS beat osimertinib; a subcutaneous version improves convenience.

name: Inlexzo (TAR-200)
why: Intravesical gemcitabine system approved 2025 with high complete response rates; moving into earlier bladder cancer.

name: Padcev (enfortumab vedotin) + Keytruda
why: EV+P is the new first-line standard; perioperative muscle-invasive trials (EV-303/304) widen it.

name: Imdelltra (tarlatamab)
why: DLL3 T-cell engager with OS win in second line; moving into first line.

name: Tryngolza (olezarsen)
why: sHTG approval 24 Jun 2026 with an 85% cut in acute pancreatitis; a much larger market than FCS.

name: bepirovirsen
why: Antisense oligonucleotide aiming at finite-therapy functional cure; B-Well Ph3 program; hundreds of millions infected.

name: ianalumab
why: First potential disease-modifying Sjögren's drug (BAFF-R); two positive Ph3s.

name: Rhapsido (remibrutinib)
why: Oral BTK inhibitor approved for CSU 2025; MS Ph3 is the bigger long-term option.

name: fenebrutinib
why: Reversible BTK inhibitor; positive Ph3 in RMS and PPMS; oral successor to Ocrevus.

name: giredestrant
why: Oral SERD with positive evERA and adjuvant lidERA ambitions; adjuvant use is the big market.

name: camizestrant
why: SERENA-6 switch-on-mutation strategy; ctDNA-guided treatment could become standard.

name: Jaypirca (pirtobrutinib)
why: Non-covalent BTK inhibitor moving to earlier CLL lines after head-to-head data.

name: intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157/V940)
why: Individualised neoantigen mRNA therapy; INTerpath Ph3 data would validate personalised cancer vaccines.

name: pumitamig (BNT327)
why: PD-L1xVEGF bispecific with a broad Ph3 program; class still unproven against Keytruda in the West.

name: Exdensur (depemokimab)
why: First twice-yearly asthma biologic (approved Dec 2025); convenience could take share.

name: Ohtuvayre (ensifentrine)
why: First new inhaled COPD mechanism in years; strong early uptake; combo inhalers next.

name: Tezspire (tezepelumab)
why: Upstream TSLP blocker; COPD Ph3 could double the opportunity.

name: Brinsupri (brensocatib)
why: First DPP1 inhibitor and first bronchiectasis drug (2025); strong launch, but valuation already rich.

name: Myqorzo (aficamten)
why: Next-gen cardiac myosin inhibitor with simpler monitoring than mavacamten.

name: Kerendia (finerenone)
why: Non-steroidal MRA now in heart failure; a pillar of cardiorenal therapy.

name: Vyvgart (efgartigimod)
why: FcRn leader with prefilled syringe; many trials, but crowded class and full valuation.

name: Imaavy (nipocalimab)
why: Broad-label FcRn blocker; pregnancy (HDFN) data differentiate it.

name: Pluvicto (lutetium-177 vipivotide tetraxetan)
why: Radioligand leader moving earlier (PSMAfore, PSMAddition); the radiopharma platform matters into the 2040s.

name: Kisqali (ribociclib)
indication: HR+ early and metastatic breast cancer
why: Adjuvant NATALEE label makes it the leading CDK4/6; runs to the 2030s.

name: Fabhalta (iptacopan)
why: Oral factor B inhibitor across complement kidney diseases.

name: islatravir + lenacapavir (weekly oral)
why: Once-weekly oral treatment; Ph3 data support filing; extends HIV franchises past Biktarvy LOE.

name: saruparib
why: PARP1-selective inhibitor with better tolerability; prostate Ph3 data Q4 2027.

name: Trodelvy (sacituzumab govitecan)
why: ASCENT-04 moves it into first-line TNBC with pembrolizumab.

name: Tecvayli + Talvey (teclistamab, talquetamab)
why: Bispecifics moving into earlier lines; combo data (MajesTEC/RedirecTT) drive the franchise.

name: Caplyta (lumateperone)
why: Adjunctive MDD approval broadens a well-tolerated antipsychotic; anchors J&J neuroscience.

name: Crenessity (crinecerfont)
why: First CRF1 antagonist for CAH; strong early adoption in an orphan market.

name: apitegromab
why: Muscle-targeted anti-myostatin; 2025 CRL was manufacturing-site related; resubmission pending.

name: tozorakimab
why: Anti-IL-33 with dual mechanism; Ph3 OBERON/TITANIA readouts decide a large COPD opportunity.

name: Leqvio (inclisiran)
why: Twice-yearly LDL siRNA; ORION-4 and VICTORION outcomes data due.

name: Repatha (evolocumab)
why: VESALIUS-CV extends benefit to high-risk primary prevention; faces oral PCSK9 competition.

name: VAX-31
why: 31-valent conjugate vaccine with the broadest coverage; adult Ph3 under way.

name: Capvaxive (V116)
why: Adult-designed serotype coverage; replacing older pneumococcal vaccines in adults.

name: Vabysmo (faricimab)
why: Bispecific Ang-2/VEGF-A; now the leading branded retina drug.

name: Eylea HD (aflibercept 8 mg)
why: Longer dosing intervals defend a franchise eroding to biosimilars and Vabysmo.

name: tavapadon
why: Once-daily D1/D5 partial agonist; filed 2025; motor fluctuations without classic dopamine side effects.

name: COMP360 (psilocybin)
why: Ph3 COMP005 positive; COMP006 data key; would be the first approved psychedelic therapy.

name: Spravato (esketamine)
why: Monotherapy label broadened use; one of the fastest-growing CNS brands.

name: PF-08634404 (SSGJ-707)
why: PD-1xVEGF bispecific licensed for $1.25B upfront; global Ph3s start 2026.

name: MET-097i
why: Ultra-long-acting injectable GLP-1; centrepiece of Pfizer's ~$10B obesity re-entry.

name: petrelintide
why: Long-acting amylin analog designed for better tolerability; Ph2b data 2026.

name: VK2735
why: GLP-1/GIP dual agonist (sc and oral); late entrant without clear differentiation or partner.

name: Wainua (eplontersen)
why: CARDIO-TTRansform, the largest ATTR-CM outcomes trial, decides the cardiac label.

name: Ekterly (sebetralstat)
why: First oral on-demand HAE therapy (2025); replaces injections for attacks.

name: Elevidys (delandistrogene moxeparvovec)
why: Gene therapy hit by 2025 safety deaths and label limits; demand and policy risk.

name: amlitelimab
why: Anti-OX40L with infrequent dosing; Ph3 efficacy looked modest against Dupixent's bar.

name: pegozafermin
why: FGF21 analog for cirrhotic MASH; competes directly with efruxifermin.

name: Inluriyo (imlunestrant)
why: Oral SERD approved 2025; combos with abemaciclib and adjuvant trial extend it.

name: Tagrisso (osimertinib)
why: Standard of care across stages; under pressure from amivantamab; LOE early 2030s.

name: nexiguran ziclumeran (nex-z, NTLA-2001)
why: One-time in vivo CRISPR knockout of TTR; MAGNITUDE paused after a 2025 liver safety event; platform bellwether.

name: sonrotoclax
why: Next-gen BCL2 to pair with Brukinsa

name: Blenrep (belantamab mafodotin)
why: BCMA ADC returned on DREAMM-7/8 survival

name: anitocabtagene autoleucel (anito-cel)
why: BCMA CAR-T with no delayed neurotoxicity so far

name: rinatabart sesutecan (Rina-S)
why: FRα ADC for all expression levels

name: Empaveli / Syfovre (pegcetacoplan)
why: C3 franchise across eye and kidney

name: gepotidacin (Blujepa)
why: First new oral UTI antibiotic class in decades

name: Opdivo / Opdivo Qvantig (nivolumab)
why: Subcutaneous switch defends PD-1 franchise into 2028 LOE

name: CAR-T for lupus (in vivo and autologous)
in vivo CAR-T (Capstan, Interius, EsoBiotec)
why: Off-the-shelf CAR-T without apheresis; big pharma bought in

name: Jardiance (empagliflozin)
why: SGLT2 class scale; IRA price cut

name: VERVE-102 (PCSK9 base editing)
why: One-shot LDL lowering; Lilly bought Verve

name: Awiqli (insulin icodec)
why: Weekly basal insulin; US CRL then resubmission
